sources.text:
Vaskijärvi Strict Nature Reserve with its surroundings is one of the largest areas in Southwestern Finlands which still are wilderness-like. Located next to Kurjenrahka National Park, the nature reserve is usually characterized by almost unbroken tranquility, with only the Cranes shouting and Dragonflies buzzing.
